timing: retrospective specification of previously generated candidate

sourceFacts.fact: MonosomyX means one X chromosome copy, described as45,X.
Turner syndrome also includes mosaic or structurally altered X chromosome patterns.

invariants: Exactly two X icons versus exactly one; no ghost copy.
Only one Turner pattern; mosaic and structural patterns explicitly remain possible.
expectedLabels: One chromosome pattern seen in Turner syndrome
Other Turner patterns include mosaicism and structural X changes
layoutSpecification: Simple hand-painted chromosome COPY-COUNT comparison only, no internal anatomy, patient face, cell mechanism or physical chromosome-band map. Title 'Monosomy X'. Left heading 'Two X copies': EXACTLY TWO identical teal X-shaped chromosome symbols, well separated. Small label underneath '46,XX'. Right heading 'One X copy': EXACTLY ONE identical teal X-shaped chromosome symbol, centred. Small label underneath '45,X'. No dashed or ghost second X on right: absence must be literal blank space. Bottom sentence 'One chromosome pattern seen in Turner syndrome'. Very small additional line 'Other Turner patterns include mosaicism and structural X changes'. This is a conceptual count diagram; X-shaped symbols are chromosome icons and not a karyotype. Maintain exact2vs1 count.
forbiddenAnatomy: No claimed anatomical reconstruction, diagnostic image, histology or literal neuroanatomical pathway
No organ cutaways or invented internal spatial relationships
